lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows spanning the mid-to-posterior flank, with higher density clusters located posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, forming a repetitive grid-like spatial arrangement across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge to deep-shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple sub-cylindrical, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) positioned ventral to the primary pectoral fin and along the lower mid-flank.
